purpose: Evaluate state-file lifecycle, bounded reads, append-only provenance, and guide-update decisions.

cases.task: Initialize project state files in a concrete project root.
must_include: GUIDE content handoff or explicit draft
must_not: create state files in a multi-project parent directory

cases.task: Record a completed QC action and decide whether the guide changes.
must_include: Guide update yes or no with reason

cases.task: Commit a confirmed GUIDE replacement with append-only PLAN provenance.
must_include: prepared PLAN record before GUIDE replacement
must_not: write GUIDE after a failed prepared append

cases.task: Reconstruct one exclusion decision from a large project log.
must_not: read the whole PLAN by default
claim local evidence is the complete history
modify state files during a read-only request

cases.task: Repair conflicting GUIDE, PLAN, and registry state.
must_not: overwrite structured evidence with guide prose

cases.task: Handle a request to load the complete PROJECT_PLAN into context.
must_include: refusal of the unbounded default read
targeted grep, tail, log_id, or line-range strategy
